messages:
maria-cs: FYI Crescent is seeing mixed 429 and intermittent 401s during SDK boot in staging. Ticket C-421, started after they changed their edge.
liam-eng: Can you get a minimal failing request and whether it's many clients or one host?
maria-cs: Single host. Sanitized payload:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <jwt>
{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}
```
They get a 401 ~1/10 requests and 429 bursts (~30s).
zara-ps: Suspects: gateway mutating/trimming Authorization, or client clock skew causing JWT rejects. Token TTL?
maria-cs: TTL is 15s, they refresh frequently, using serverless pool with many pre-warmed lambdas.
sam-sre: Short TTL + bursty concurrency = refresh stampede. Also proxies can drop Authorization -> 401. Ask them to add X-Debug-Id and capture headers.
liam-eng: Tell them to run:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Debug-Id: probe123" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"probe"}'
```
We need to see header arrival.
maria-cs: Sent. Also, deploy-bot: deploy made by liam-eng at 2026-03-21T09:12:00Z :rocket:
liam-eng: If nginx is in chain, check `proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;` — missing it can strip auth when proxying.
zara-ps: Mitigation: increase TTL to 60s and add jitter to refresh.
maria-cs: Customer logs (tokens redacted):
``
[2026-03-21T09:20:13Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe123 req=abc123
[2026-03-21T09:20:13Z] 401 Unauthorized X-Debug-Id=probe124 req=abc124 auth=missing
[2026-03-21T09:20:14Z] 429 Too Many Requests X-Debug-Id=probe125 req=abc125 rate=client_concurrency
[2026-03-21T09:20:15Z] 200 OK X-Debug-Id=probe126 req=abc126
```
They see Authorization flagged as missing in some requests.
sam-sre: Likely header dropped by WAF/proxy or header-size limit. Any WAF/CDN?
maria-cs: Yes — WAF + API gateway. They changed WAF rules recently.
liam-eng: Have them bypass the WAF briefly or forward Authorization untouched to confirm. If 401s go away it's the WAF.
maria-cs: They disabled suspect WAF groups and retested. Result: 10/10 200s, and far fewer 429s after reducing concurrent refresh.
liam-eng: Next steps: (1) remove/adjust WAF rule that mangles headers, (2) raise token TTL to ~60s with jitter during onboarding, (3) monitor and we can whitelist IP for a short ramp if needed.
zara-ps: I'll draft a short checklist for common gateways (nginx, envoy) + token guidance and share as a gist.
maria-cs: I'll update ticket with mitigations and request their WAF post-mortem. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
liam-eng: Offer: we can provision a temporary elevated rate window for 24h to smooth onboarding if they prefer.
maria-cs: I'll offer that and close the loop with the customer.
